Initial release.

- Provides audience-fit scoring for influencers on YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram based on multiple audience dimensions (geography, language, age, gender, interest, behavior, authenticity, rating tiers).
- Includes a capability matrix with mapped API operations for each supported platform.
- Supports dimension-by-dimension scoring, confidence metrics, score breakdowns, and clear go/test/no-go recommendations.
- Offers workflow guidance, command-line tooling, and detailed output contract for consistent use.
- Handles vague audience definitions (ICP), missing data, and quota exhaustion scenarios with clear user prompts.
